conventions.convention: Work over R = Q[x₁,…,xₙ], n ≥ 2, with deg xⱼ = 2 and internal shift M(1)ₐ = Mₐ₊₁; v[X] = [X(1)].

The positive generator complex has Bᵢ → R(1) in cochain degrees 0,1; the negative generator has R(−1) → Bᵢ in degrees −1,0. Words use signed tensor totalization, left-to-right bracketing, and the empty word gives R in degree zero.
The Hecke normalization is Φ([Bᵢ]) = Hᵢ = v(Tᵢ + 1), with q = v⁻². The exponent sum counts positive letters minus negative letters.
The positive Artin crossing is read upward, with the right input strand passing over the left input strand.

The KLR presentation uses Qᵢⱼ(u,v) = Qⱼᵢ(v,u), dot degree 2dᵢ, crossing degree −dᵢaᵢⱼ, and the displayed divided-difference correction for the ordered braid commutator. Its diagram is read upward and does not assert invertibility of crossings.

The counterexample has unshifted R in cochain degrees 0 and 1 and zero differential; its cohomology is computed in the ambient abelian category of graded bimodules, not inside the additive Soergel category.

Physical defect realization requires separately specified physical data and a strong monoidal realization functor; neither the Rouquier construction nor the KLR contract asserts a physical realization.

load_bearing.statement: For a signed word σ, F(σ) is the signed tensor totalization of its positive and negative Rouquier generator complexes. For its braid β, F(β) is this complex considered up to the canonical homotopy equivalence between words representing β; tensor product is categorical stacking.

For β ∈ Bₙ, Φ(χ(F(β))) = v^{e(β)}T_β. Consequently β ↦ v^{−e(β)}Φ(χ(F(β))) is the standard Hecke braid homomorphism, and its normalization is multiplicative under braid stacking. Homotopy-equivalent complexes have the same Euler class, but need not be isomorphic as graded complexes.

published_dependencies.used_for: Polynomial grading, permutation action, invariant rings, and the internal-shift dictionary.
The precise bimodule Bᵢ and its grading.
The additive idempotent-complete category, degree-zero morphisms, tensor product, and nonzero unit R.
The cochain totalization and its Koszul sign, independent of internal grading.
Split Grothendieck relations, tensor multiplication, and v[X] = [X(1)].
Generator differentials, cochain degrees, shifts, and comparison with source normalizations.
Finite signed-word tensor construction and empty-word convention.
Checking the meaning of canonical comparison: uniqueness of the internal-degree-zero homotopy class with prescribed derived image.
Transitivity and inverse identities for normalized comparisons.
Coherent tensor multiplication, units, and the action on Kᵇ(R-grmod).
Word independence up to canonical isomorphism in the homotopy category, rather than equality of complexes.
The Hecke quadratic relation, q = v⁻², and normalized generators Hᵢ.
The algebra isomorphism Φ and its exact generator and shift values.
The contracting-homotopy equation used in both the proposition and counterexample.
Euler-class homotopy invariance and multiplicativity for arbitrary bounded Soergel complexes.
The exact values vTᵢ and v⁻¹Tᵢ⁻¹ and their extension to signed words.
Artin relations and invariance and additivity of exponent sum.
